acceptanceCriteria.criterion: PostgreSQL JDBC driver configured in Spring Boot (latest version, 15+ compatibility)
Connection pool configured (HikariCP: 10 min, 20 max connections, 30s timeout)
Spring Data JPA configured with PostgreSQL dialect
Flyway migration tool integrated for schema versioning (V1__initial_schema.sql, etc.)
Initial schema migration script created (CUSTOMER, POLICY, AUDIT_LOG, FEATURE_TOGGLE tables with indexes)
Environment-specific PostgreSQL connection strings configured (dev uses local, test uses testcontainer, prod uses managed DB)
Connection health check working via Spring Actuator: GET /actuator/health/db returns {"status":"UP","details":{"database":"PostgreSQL"}}
Database connection tested with successful query execution (SELECT 1)
Docker Compose includes PostgreSQL service for local development

constraint.name: PostgreSQL JDBC Driver Version
constraint.description: Must use PostgreSQL JDBC driver version 42.7.x or compatible with Spring Boot 3.3.4

constraint.name: HikariCP Connection Pool Sizing
constraint.description: Dev: minimum-idle: 10, maximum-pool-size: 20, connection-timeout: 30s; Prod: minimum-idle: 5, maximum-pool-size: 20; Test: use TestContainers defaults

constraint.name: DDL Auto Strategy per Profile
constraint.description: Dev: create-drop, Test: create-drop, Prod: validate (Flyway manages schema)

constraint.name: Flyway Migration Locations
constraint.description: Main migrations: classpath:db/migration/; Test migrations: separate test directory; Naming: V{number}__{description}.sql

constraint.name: Initial Schema Tables
constraint.description: V1__initial_schema.sql MUST create: CUSTOMER, POLICY, AUDIT_LOG, FEATURE_TOGGLE tables with documented indexes and foreign keys

constraint.name: Actuator Health Endpoint Database Component
constraint.description: GET /actuator/health/db must return database component health with PostgreSQL dialect confirmation

constraint.name: Docker Compose PostgreSQL Service
constraint.description: PostgreSQL 16-alpine service with proper environment variables, volume persistence, and health checks

constraint.name: Layered Architecture Pattern
constraint.description: Follow Spring layered architecture: configuration → data access layer (JPA repositories) → business logic → REST controllers; do not mix concerns

constraint.name: TestContainers Pattern for Integration Tests
constraint.description: Use @Testcontainers annotation and PostgreSQL container for integration tests; do not use H2 for database-specific testing

interface.name: DataSource Bean
interface.signature: @Bean public DataSource dataSource() { return new HikariDataSource(hikariConfig()); }
interface.description: Spring-managed JDBC DataSource with HikariCP pooling; auto-configured via spring.datasource properties if using standard configuration

interface.name: JPA Repository Pattern
interface.signature: public interface EntityRepository extends JpaRepository<Entity, UUID> { ... }
interface.description: Spring Data JPA repositories for entity persistence; implemented in subsequent stories (Story 2.1 for Customer, Story 5.1 for Policy)

interface.name: Actuator Health Endpoint - Database Component
interface.description: Returns health status of database connection; auto-configured when DataSource is present

interface.name: Flyway Migration
interface.description: SQL-based schema versioning; Flyway executes on startup if enabled in configuration

tests.standards: Database connectivity testing in Spring Boot 3.3 follows these standards: (1) Use @SpringBootTest with @ActiveProfiles("test") for integration tests, (2) Use @Testcontainers and PostgreSQL container for database-specific testing, (3) Use H2 in-memory database as alternative for fast unit tests, (4) Test profile should use TestContainers PostgreSQL or H2 to avoid external dependencies, (5) All tests should verify DataSource bean creation, HikariCP pool initialization, Flyway migration execution, and health endpoint responses, (6) Integration tests should be placed in src/test/java with package structure matching src/main/java, (7) Use JUnit 5 (Jupiter) with Mockito for mocking non-database components.

location.description: Integration tests for application context and profiles

idea.title: PostgreSQL JDBC Driver Configuration Test
idea.description: Verify PostgreSQL JDBC driver is loaded and registered; test DataSource bean creation with correct PostgreSQL dialect
idea.approach: Unit test: instantiate DataSource, verify org.postgresql.Driver is registered; Integration test: @SpringBootTest with PostgreSQL TestContainer

idea.title: HikariCP Connection Pool Initialization Test
idea.description: Verify HikariCP pool is initialized with correct sizing (min/max connections, timeout)
idea.approach: Integration test: Inject HikariDataSource bean, verify getMaximumPoolSize(), getMinimumIdle(), getConnectionTimeout() match configuration

idea.title: Spring Data JPA PostgreSQL Dialect Test
idea.description: Verify JPA is configured with PostgreSQL dialect and Hibernate mapping works
idea.approach: Integration test: Load ApplicationContext, verify EntityManagerFactory uses PostgreSQL dialect; test basic entity CRUD operations

idea.title: Flyway Migration Execution Test
idea.description: Verify Flyway executes V1__initial_schema.sql on application startup; verify schema tables are created
idea.approach: Integration test: Start application with Flyway enabled, query information_schema to verify CUSTOMER, POLICY, AUDIT_LOG, FEATURE_TOGGLE tables exist

idea.title: Environment-Specific Connection Strings Test
idea.description: Verify dev/test/prod profiles load correct database connection strings
idea.approach: Unit test: @ActiveProfiles("dev"/"test"/"prod") load correct application-{profile}.yml; verify connection URL, username, pool sizing

idea.title: Health Endpoint Database Component Test
idea.description: Verify /actuator/health/db returns UP status with PostgreSQL database details
idea.approach: Integration test: Make HTTP GET request to /actuator/health/db, verify response structure and database component status

idea.title: Database Connection Query Execution Test
idea.description: Verify connection pool can execute queries (SELECT 1) successfully
idea.approach: Integration test: Obtain JDBC connection from DataSource, execute test query, verify no exceptions

idea.title: Docker Compose PostgreSQL Service Integration Test
idea.description: Verify Docker Compose PostgreSQL service is accessible and functional
idea.approach: Integration test (optional): docker-compose up, wait for health check, run application with dev profile, verify connection succeeds

idea.title: Schema Creation Validation Test
idea.description: Verify V1__initial_schema.sql creates tables with correct structure: columns, data types, indexes, constraints
idea.approach: Integration test: After Flyway migration, query information_schema.columns to verify table structure matches specification
